name: Dumbbell Alternating Hammer Curl to Press
steps: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hold a dumbbell at each side with thumbs pointing forward.
Brace your core and curl one dumbbell to your shoulder while keeping your palm facing inward.
Press that dumbbell straight overhead until your arm extends while the other arm stays at your side.
Lower the dumbbell back to your shoulder and down to your side, then alternate arms.
tips: Keep your ribs stacked over your hips as the dumbbell passes overhead.
Avoid leaning sideways or using knee bounce to drive the weight upward.
